scope: FRANK loop/log/state fusion; quality-gate hardening; policy/receipt provenance binding

pre_fix_reproducer.policy_identity_gap: The same readout could produce identical receipts under different controller thresholds when the decision did not change, and readout_sha256 stayed identical even when a threshold changed the decision. No policy hash or receipt hash existed.

changes: reject non-finite numeric telemetry before recurrence classification
reject negative epochs/streaks/measurement ages and negative state delta/residual pressure
validate controller threshold domain and ordering
domain-separate readout, policy and receipt hashes
bind controller_policy_id and thresholds into policy_sha256
bind readout_sha256 plus policy_sha256 plus decision metadata into receipt_sha256
preserve NONE external-effect authority and effect-gate requirement

local_regression.environment: ChatGPT Python sandbox/local proxy; not target Ubuntu
local_regression.note: The Python subprocess emitted an unrelated artifact_tool spreadsheet warmup timeout on stderr before unittest output; unittest execution itself returned exit code 0 and all 13 tests passed.

checked_invariants: invalid telemetry cannot mint a recurrence decision
valid stale/high-uncertainty telemetry routes rather than converges
decision receipts remain proposal-only and effect-ineligible

remaining_falsifiers: run the v0.2 component and expanded tests on the target Ubuntu developer host
integrate the quality gate into the ordinary-code H1 executable spine
run frozen/live-derived Golden Traces through state-ledger -> loop-readout -> quality-gate -> trajectory decision -> GWT/effect non-authority path
calibrate thresholds per residual estimator/version from observed H1 traces
compare typed adaptive recurrence against tuned fixed-budget, delta-only and event-driven baselines under matched outcome/latency/compute/recovery cost
evaluate whether state_version_hash and trace_root_hash should be bound directly into recurrence receipts
